mode: Built-in reference-guided generation, three distinct compositions

visualReview.method: Direct inspection of native generated tool outputs
character: All three retain the broad cyan hood, tiny cyan body, beige face, short angled brows, V mouth and gray segmented collar.
The original character reference takes precedence over the prior scene character.
Figures remain AI reference redrawings, not pixel-exact insertion of the source sprite.
terrain: Terracotta foreground has long sediment bands and red weathered rock faces.
Sage slate foreground uses large oblique plates, white seams and peripheral cascade.
Moon-white foreground uses pale lilac shaded mineral masses, pink crust and dark wine-red ecology.
All three retain supported irregular side-view terrain with exposed top planes and thick front faces.
limitations: All are static concept illustrations; no looping animation, Spine rig or particle resources were produced.
Salt/chalk painting may also suggest frost or ice and requires material refinement if selected.
Texture complexity and character scale vary; production requires a unified palette and native camera check.
Illustrated mineral positions and ledge geometry are not collision, mining reach, tile seam or WFC verification.
